description: This file defines a security configuration class for a Spring Boot application. It configures HTTP security, including CORS, request authorization, and the addition of a custom JWT authentication filter.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up security filters, CORS policies, request authorization, and custom security filters for the application.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain, configuring CSRF, CORS, authorization rules, and adding a JWT authentication filter.
